entries.title: The reactor surrogate is a native extent-fixed unit solved on `revision_eo`, not the experiment inside M02's coupling
Surrogate inputs: seven affine-scaled inlet coordinates; outputs: M02's (X, ΔT); inadmissible predictions refused, never projected
The reference distribution is uniform on a registered box inside the data domain (`m04-c1-box7-v1`)
One joint conformal score whose scales are the declared width limits
A failed draw scores +∞ and stays in n or m; a draw without a deterministic result makes the plan incomplete
The iteration-1 plan: 144 / 118 / 300 draws and 5 gradient centres, registered by seed before the parent runs
Promotion: an integer coverage test against 0.90, q̂ ≤ 1, admissibility and a 25 % gradient limit; IE > NP > PROMOTABLE
The empirical domain is the reference box, flagged with its scaled excess; the hard domain is the parent's
Surrogate promotion and rollback are ADR 0035's checked commit plus the facet `surrogate_evidence` and one `derivatives` exception
A further iteration redraws calibration and test, trains on all earlier reference draws, and is automatic only after a coverage-only failure
A later surrogate iteration lists the earlier reference draws as requests; `it2` and `it3` are committed; admission enforces when one may run
M04's floats need no new class: R1/R2 given the same records, conditional R0 decisions with a 10⁻⁸ gap rule
ModelEvidence names its manifest by hash; the manifest does not hash its evidence
The surrogate study's outputs and refusals: manifest then evidence; a budget refusal writes nothing; plan refusals at admission
Concurrency for surrogate studies is a cache pre-warm with `experiment` jobs, at most the physical cores; the study stays sequential
M04's served-surface additions are checked by stripping (R-234's pattern); `max_cold_experiments` is a Q26 pinned scalar
W27 Amendment 3: `c1.reactor_surrogate` performs no function, for a new reason `surrogate_model`; J3–J6 compare a surrogate-carrying build with `hypothetical_v02_a3`
Corpus tests that bind every builder get a fixture-only `SurrogateResolver`, not an exclusion list
The real reactor's surrogate gets its own reference box `m04-c1-box7-v2` and plan family `b2-it1…3`; the v1 plans become synthetic-only (closes M04 N4)
`surrogate_evidence` reports every reason, each failure cause is tested alone, and an unresolvable manifest fails closed (M04 build log E15, E16)
The M04 synthetic parents enter a project only through a test-only injection, checked not to leak (M04 build log E22)
A fixture whose only drift is its environment fingerprint is not re-taken; it is compared with a fresh run outside a closed environment set (M04 build log E23)
Promotion covers every way a surrogate enters a revision: an added, renamed or first-revision surrogate instance needs a PROMOTABLE re-derived verdict (M04 review MF1)
The manifest checker ties `failed`/`incomplete` lists to null scores, centre statuses and `training_ok` (M04 review MF2)
The study's fit runs under one BLAS thread; the manifest does not record the thread setting; A32 is bitwise per platform at any thread setting (M04 build log E33)
With no predictor the score-, band- and gradient-dependent reasons are not evaluated (M04 review SF2)
WO-11's NOT_PROMOTABLE (`band_not_finite`) is M04's real outcome; no box, plan or counting amendment; b2-it2/3 are not admissible

limitations: The real surrogate is NOT_PROMOTABLE (band_not_finite): WO-11 on `b2-it1` with reactor v3 recorded 26 of 632 registered experiments as deterministic reactor_not_accepted(certificate) (calibration 5/118, gradient 0/5, test 18/300, training 3/144), so k = 114 of n = 118 tolerates only 4 null scores and q̂ = +∞ (recorded as null). This is a measured property of v3 (§19 A2.13), not a defect of M04; per N6 M04 is `tested` whatever the real verdict, and M05 proceeds with the parent. The real surrogate claims nothing beyond its recorded verdict.

A33 (the real surrogate in `C1-LOOP-M02-v1`, rollback, one promoted commit) was not run: it is conditional on a PROMOTABLE A31. Q-A2.1 (does the surrogate-backed loop's reactor inlet lie in box v2?) stays open without A33's record.

The real-reactor records (A31, A32, A41) are opt-in: the pinned reactor environment, Linux, one machine, read here and not re-run. A32's bitwise manifest equality holds on that platform at any thread setting: the fit runs under one BLAS thread (R-362, A49; build decision E36), and WO-11's study re-submitted from cache gave `d65bb022…` at one and at 48 threads; across platforms §18 A1.3's classes govern.

The W23 rows here are numerical verification of §15's items; W23's verdict is the `verdict` lane's, not this manifest's. Self-generated outputs (the A19 fixtures, the WO-11 record) are regression evidence; the correctness assertions rest on the specification's closed forms and the generator's independent reference values (A34).
